summary: Major operational release with improved inventory and reporting, receipt printing, stronger backup and recovery, live Paystack billing, and Early Adopter pricing for the website edition.
features: Refined inventory workflows for purchases, wastage, stock adjustments and low-stock visibility.
Expanded reports for sales, payment methods, stock activity, wastage and cash-up review.
Print receipts for completed sales with shop, order, payment, item, customization and total information.
Improved business backup and restore flows with stronger ownership and restore validation.
Live Paystack subscriptions for the website edition, including recurring payment reconciliation and cancellation handling.
Early Adopter pricing for the first 10 eligible customers: R25 weekly, R89 monthly or R890 yearly.
Improved trial-expiry and subscription-status messaging before access changes.
Improved responsive layouts for phones, tablets and rotated Android devices.
Core sales, menu, inventory and reporting workflows continue to operate locally when connectivity is unavailable after setup.
fixes: Improved customized-order ingredient costing and inventory deductions.
Improved South African date handling across daily reports and operational figures.
Hardened returning-user, registered-device and archived-business handling.
Improved backup and recovery safeguards around locally stored business data.
Improved payment fulfillment idempotency, provider verification and subscription lifecycle reconciliation.
Various stability, layout and production-monitoring improvements.
